$schema_note: Eval cases for rai-orm incremental routing. Synthetic campus fixture shared with rai-orm-from-workload; manual, in-session runs, with state CLI automation in tools/test_resume_flow.py.
v0_1_pass_bar: R-E1, R-E2 and R-E3 preserve baseline artifacts or block explicitly; no Python-only import and no hidden budget stop.

cases.description: Resume an existing ORM model after its original five-round invocation was exhausted.
cases.fixture_setup: Build a campus model, digest and bound PyRel; record its actual project emitter. Preserve a verification report with rounds 0 through 5, saved passed rewrites, original item split assignments and stopped_because: budget. Initialize orm-state.json with the schema and workload hashes. Record the exact current model_revision only after a baseline recheck; legacy reports must first block. Use manual:step-10 for skill-built models.
cases.prompt: Continue this ORM model from where it stopped, with five more rounds and patience two.

expected_behavior.route: Step 0 resume check; no repeated intake, schema recovery or unchanged digest extraction; connectivity -> rai-orm-verify <-> rai-orm-refactor -> report
expected_behavior.baseline: Old model at round 5 (N+0); next repair round is 6, with a fresh invocation allowance
expected_behavior.verification: Keep prior round history, split, oracle and accepted PyRel; append invocations entry and run prior passes only as regressions
expected_behavior.report: State latest invocation rounds and total rounds; budget exhaustion leads with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and exact continuation action

pass_criteria: state.py plan starts at round 6 and lists prior passed ids as frozen
Original saved PyRel is retained until any explicit rename candidate is accepted
The split is read from the previous report and never recomputed
A repair with more regressions than fixes restores the consistent snapshot
Refactor acceptance retains total and per-split verified passes and shares this invocation budget
No completion claim while a blocker issue stands
Legacy verification without an exact revision match yields BASELINE_RECHECK_REQUIRED and can_resume: false
First update records the invocation start; rounds_used_this_invocation excludes the baseline
Missing or duplicate workload/verification IDs and count mismatches block update and completion

cases.description: Resume campus with structured and free-text feedback about the planted missing Enrollment-Student link.
cases.fixture_setup: Preserve an existing campus model and verification state. Add feedback.yaml version 1 with id campus_link, kind missing_link, from Enrollment, to Student. Add optional feedback.md expressing a grain concern without data values.
cases.prompt: Improve the existing ORM model using this feedback in Guided mode.

expected_behavior.feedback: Plan lists new structured feedback with source: user-feedback; the agent converts markdown into feedback.processed.yaml and shows that batch before applying
expected_behavior.repair: Probe the candidate columns read-only; commit proposed fact types through the original modeling skill; reuse recorded emitter
expected_behavior.delta: Unchanged workload and digest are retained; only newly added or changed item ids are re-digested if the workload changes; preserve an immutable old workload snapshot or per-item contributions; legacy subtraction without either requires the explicit full rebuild fallback
expected_behavior.stop: Connectivity before verify, refactor assessment after, then report; missing emitter blocks application

pass_criteria: Guided structured feedback is reviewed before application
Feedback item and file hashes prevent presenting already processed items again
Connectivity overlap evidence contains counts and column names only
Tools output no markdown feedback, question text, SQL literals or data values
Model.py is regenerated by the existing recorded command, never patched
Removing emitter_command produces EMITTER_REQUIRED with can_resume: false
Connectivity uses repair.digest.yaml; holdout.digest.yaml measures only
Emitter idempotency runs only in a temporary sandbox copy and preserves YAML, Python and digest hashes; unavailable sandboxes yield EMITTER_UNVERIFIED
Applied fact IDs/readings must appear in changed Python or EMITTER_INCOMPLETE blocks acceptance
Binding changes invalidate verification, deleted emitter files block resume, and changed rewrite paths require explicit verified acceptance
Malformed feedback and workloads produce structured blockers while planning continues
In One-shot only required-gap links auto-apply; exploratory proposals remain for review

cases.description: An existing Python model without ORM YAML cannot be imported by v0.1.
cases.fixture_setup: Create a small synthetic model.py in a project directory without model.orm.yaml or orm-state.json.
cases.prompt: Resume this ORM model from model.py and apply the feedback.

expected_behavior.blocker: YAML_REQUIRED; v0.1 does not import model.py into ORM YAML
expected_behavior.manual_path: Preserve Python/bindings, obtain schema or domain artifacts, author/review YAML through a modeling skill, manually reconcile identities and bindings, establish an emitter, compare coverage, then initialize state
expected_behavior.alternative: Route loaded PyRel review without an ORM stage to rai-ontology-design

pass_criteria: No execution, import or introspection of Python to manufacture YAML
No overwrite of the existing model.py or bindings
The refusal explains the manual path and does not claim completion
PYREL_REQUIRED names existing semantics-importing candidates; --model-py points at the existing file and never creates a second one

running_evals.manual_methodology: Run in-session on synthetic project copies; preserve before/after artifacts and state plans for review.
running_evals.automation_status: Manifest and plan invariants are covered by tools/test_state.py and tools/test_resume_flow.py; modeling and oracle acceptance remain agent workflows.
